datasets.name: 34e5acbb
queryLines:
SELECT
  risk_segment,
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percentage
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions
GROUP BY risk_segment;

datasets.name: 22f0629f
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.risk_segment,
  SUM(f.MonthlyCharges) AS revenue_at_risk
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions p
JOIN gold.customer_churn_features f
ON p.customerID = f.customerID
GROUP BY p.risk_segment;

datasets.name: 3e52825e
queryLines:
SELECT
  recommended_action,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions
GROUP BY recommended_action;

datasets.name: 82d76236
datasets.displayName: Average Churn Probability by Contract Type
queryLines:
SELECT
  Contract,
  AVG(churn_prob) AS avg_churn_probability
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions p
JOIN gold.customer_churn_features f
ON p.customerID = f.customerID
GROUP BY Contract;

datasets.name: bd23debe
queryLines:
SELECT
    f.total_services_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.risk_segment = 'High Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_customers,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.risk_segment = 'High Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS high_risk_percentage
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions p
JOIN gold.customer_churn_features f
  ON p.customerID = f.customerID
GROUP BY f.total_services_count
ORDER BY f.total_services_count;

datasets.name: 65f0f97d
queryLines:
SELECT
    p.customerID,
    p.churn_prob,
    f.MonthlyCharges,
    p.recommended_action
FROM gold.customer_churn_predictions p
JOIN gold.customer_churn_features f
  ON p.customerID = f.customerID
WHERE p.risk_segment = 'High Risk'
ORDER BY p.churn_prob DESC, f.MonthlyCharges DESC
LIMIT 20;
